user.title: MyQ Garage Configuration
user.description: Please enter your MyQ API URL and API Key.

data_description.url: The base URL of your MyQ Garage companion API. Must use the http or https scheme and must not contain a username or password.
data_description.api_key: The API key issued by your MyQ Garage companion API.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate MyQ Garage
reauth_confirm.description: Your MyQ Garage API key is no longer valid. Enter a new API key to continue.

data_description.api_key: The new API key issued by your MyQ Garage companion API.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the MyQ API.
error.invalid_url: The API URL must use http or https, include a hostname, and must not contain a username or password.

abort.already_configured: This MyQ Garage API URL is already configured.
abort.wrong_account: The provided API key belongs to a different MyQ Garage installation than the one being reauthenticated.

init.title: MyQ Garage Options
init.description: Configure how often Home Assistant polls your MyQ Garage API.

data_description.scan_interval_seconds: How often, in seconds, Home Assistant polls the MyQ Garage API for device status. Must be between 10 and 3600 seconds.

error.invalid_scan_interval: Scan interval must be between 10 and 3600 seconds.
